resumen: The same push with the knee bent to 90°. With the gastrocnemius shortened, the work falls mainly on the soleus.
ejecucion: Sit on a bench with your feet flat and your knees at 90°.
Rest a weight on your thighs, close to the knee.
Raise your heels as high as you can and hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until the heel is down.
Since the range is short, the pause at the top counts more than the weight.
matices: In the cited trial the soleus grew the same seated as standing (2.9 % against 2.1 %), while the gastrocnemius barely grew seated. That half kills the idea that this version is essential for the soleus: it works, but it adds nothing the standing one does not already give.
